name: FPP MIDI
author: Daniel Kulp
description: Listener for MIDI messages to trigger FPP Commands

privacy.summary: Runs on this device; installs and pins a modified rtmidi system package that stays after uninstall. A mapped command can be sent to other FPP players you pick, or to every player on your network.

sends.to: the FPP players you pick in a command, or every FPP player on your network
sends.what: the FPP command you mapped to a MIDI message
sends.why: to run that command on other players in your show

systemChanges.what: installs librtmidi and a repackaged, apt-held librtmidi-dev with apt at install or when the plugin is rebuilt

privacy.other: The last 25 MIDI messages received are held in memory only, for the setup page, and are gone when fppd restarts. The librtmidi packages and the apt hold on librtmidi-dev stay after uninstall, as does the plugin.fpp-midi.json config file.
